annotation_meta.instruction: Independent AI recheck from the paper only; original ground truth was not opened.

experimental_conditions: CADD optical delay optimized between 50 ps and 60 ps with 5%-25% frequency gaps
Four iterations were used for SSBI mitigation
CADD and KK were compared at a 100 Gbit/s data rate
main_results: CADD uses double-sideband modulation and approximately doubles electrical spectral efficiency relative to KK and SSBI iterative-cancellation receivers
For a 10% frequency gap, CADD achieved about 28 dB OSNR sensitivity
CADD operation at 25% frequency gap achieved about 26 dB OSNR sensitivity while trading spectral efficiency for sensitivity
